Case Study 1

Franchise Operations Streamlined with Voice AI

Multi-Location Franchise NetworkFranchise Operations / Hospitality

Problem

Multi-location franchise was losing 30-40% of inbound leads because calls went unanswered after hours and on weekends. No single platform could coordinate call handling across all locations.

Solution

Deployed Voice Intake Concierge across all 12 franchise locations simultaneously. Calls are now answered 24/7 with AI voice that qualifies leads, handles intake, and routes to appropriate managers.

Zero missed calls across all locations

Lead capture increased by 35%

No new headcount required

First response time

< 2 seconds

"We went from losing leads to capturing every single call. The AI sounds like a trained staff member, and it never misses a shift."

Delivered in 14 days from discovery to full deployment

"CaFlow replaced a year-long pain point with a single platform. Tax season is no longer a scramble."

Delivered in 21 days to full implementation

Case Study 2

Accounting Firm Consolidated Tool Stack with CaFlow

Mid-Sized US CPA FirmProfessional Services / Accounting

Problem

Firm was managing 100 clients across four disconnected tools (TaxDome, Dext, SmartVault, QuickBooks). Document collection was manual, deadline tracking was scattered, and data had to be moved between systems by hand.

Solution

Replaced entire fragmented stack with CaFlow. Documents now arrive via structured email sequences, compliance deadlines are tracked centrally, and data flows directly into QuickBooks.

Reduced tool stack from 4 to 1 (savings

$150+/user/month)

Document collection time cut by 50%

Zero manual data entry between systems

Grew client base to 140 without adding staff
